subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c7f99a7ddee56929c0161cc4b6f10bd2575544e15922f4d714cb98c9127f83b.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f52489d0af6de39c1a498aed8b590e8186121fa8b2ddbb1708a5c6f186f4eae.png] 

As we move along the series, we see that the figure with boxes is itself rotating in 90° clockwise direction and changing its position by moving in clockwise direction.

The number of sides in the polygon in increasing by 1 and the polygon is changing its position by moving in anti-clockwise direction.

Hence, '**option 4**' is the correct answer.
